title: spec: declare the RLS deny sentinel once in `@objectstack/spec`, imported by `plugin-security` and `objectql` (ADR-0139 D2 step 2; #22861 sub-question 2 ruled (i))
body:
Filing gate: **④ a ruling's execution card.** Filed by the director seat (summon #38, `session_013UzShSJnH3HuoZgVrYF9i8`, written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay) on the maintainer's word, verbatim 「22861  objectui#12191 同意。」 (batch #327 item 1 → letter A on #22861, whose sub-question 2 is ruled **(i)**; the ruling comment and the `Ruled:` line are on #22861 in the same act). Derived from #22861, E2 of ADR-0139's plan (parent #22788). ⛔ Classes, positions and functions only.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat. Grade inherited from #22861 (`priority:p2`, `area:access`); triage may re-grade.

## The work

- Today the deny sentinel is a private literal of one plugin: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/rls-compiler.ts` exports `RLS_DENY_FILTER` (the dev's reading on #22861, 6119740461: `{ id: '__rls_deny__:0000…' }`). `objectql` cannot import a plugin, and ADR-0139 D2 step 2 needs the engine to recognise the sentinel to answer `$in: []`.
- Declare it **once** in `packages/spec/src/data/**` (beside `readable-ids.ts`), exported from the package's `data` entry, with its docblock naming D2 step 2 as the reader. `plugin-security` imports the spec's object and keeps no second literal; `objectql`'s E2 seam (#22861) imports the same object and recognises it **by identity**. ⛔ No structural equality on a guessed value shape, no duplicated string (sub-question 2's option (ii) was not offered and is not taken).
- `Clause-②: yes` — a new exported member of the published spec. One changeset, FROM → TO.

## Acceptance

- One definition in the tree: `git grep -n "__rls_deny__" -- packages` outside tests hits the spec file only; `plugin-security`'s compiler emits the spec's object (a pin asserts identity, not shape).
- The E2 card (#22861) imports it. **Serial constraint:** #22861's PR lands after this card's PR; the engine lane may draft against the constant's shape and rebase.

## Duplicate check

- MCP `search_issues` over objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: "RLS_DENY_FILTER deny sentinel declared once in @objectstack/spec shared by plugin-security and objectql" → **0 hits**. Control: "ReadableIds leaf composed fail closed ADR-0139" → 11 hits (#22861, #22787, #22678 among them).
